story: Day 100: Board datesheet aaya, Maths 17 Feb. Papa ka deal: 90% = phone. Mishti ka message raat ko; Chhotu ne phone chhupaya (A).
Day 99: Phone takiye ke neeche, Mummy 'Shabaash'. 10/10 in practice, Mishti: 'library 7 baje'. 12:45 baje devil vs angel: so jao (A) vs 1 ghanta aur (B). A jeeta.

Day 98: So gaya (neend = save button), 6 baje utha, library mein Mishti, Zeta notes se quick revision (Mishti: 'mujhe bhi bhej'). Surprise test: Chhotu 14/20 (pehle 9), Mishti 18/20. Sunday Section A class sirf 18+ walon ke liye. Chhotu 4 marks kam, Mishti ne mistakes dikhane ki offer di, Chhotu ka ego. Q: Mishti ke saath mistakes (A, sahi) ya akele (B).
Day 96 (made elsewhere): plan pe tiko vs 6 ghante copy; Zeta AI teacher draws Trigonometry at Nani's house. A won 75-6 on Day 97's vote.
Day 95 (made elsewhere): opens with Mishti's message 'Sharma ji ka beta tumse tuition le raha hai?' as a flash-forward hook (hook_peephole), Chhotu ends up teaching Sharma ji ka beta.

Day 94 (made elsewhere): chalkboard role-reverse hook (hook_chalk). What-if: Chhotu shuts the door, alone on Light. Real: teaches Sharma ji ka beta at the library ('jo sikhaoge, wo kabhi nahi bhoologe'); doesn't know when f is negative -> 'koi sab nahi jaanta, bas poochna aana chahiye' -> Zeta AI teacher together. Twist: Mummy's 'Board Moms 2027' group sends 12 tuition requests. Q: A 'hafte mein 1 session, apna plan pehle' (correct) vs B 'roz sabko padhao'.

Day 93: hook = colony tutor-request notifications. What-if B: 'Chhotu Classes' daily, Pintu eats chalk, own test 9/20. Real: 'sirf Sunday, baaki din apna plan', Mummy handles Board Moms. Sunday session from Zeta Real Numbers PYQs (HCF × LCM = a × b, only for 2 numbers); teaching = own revision. Mishti: surprise mock test tomorrow. Sharma ji ka beta asks to see answers. Q: A show answers vs B refuse + revise together tonight (B correct).

Day 92: hook = mock-test countdown 'psst, answer dikha'. What-if A: Sir catches both, 0/20, Papa called ('network issue tha?'). Real: Chhotu refuses, video-calls Sharma ji ka beta, Zeta Real Numbers quiz -> mistakes list; √2 irrational proof. Result: Chhotu 17/20, Sharma ji ka beta 15/20 on his own. Mishti: Sunday Section A entry test, only proofs. Gully group: big match all evening. Q: A 1 hr match then proofs (correct) vs B whole evening match.

Day 91: hook = zoom on Chhotu + 'bas ek over aur'. What-if B: whole-evening match, six into Sharma ji's window, Section A test 4/20 ('khidki wala shot toh perfect tha?'). Real: 1 hour, bat down at 7, Zeta Real Numbers formula sheet; 5 − √3 irrational (assume rational, isolate √3, contradiction); 'ratta nahi, pattern pakdo'. Mishti: 'Sunday dekhte hain kaun aage'. Twist: Pinky didi's wedding Sunday 10 AM, same day as the 9 AM Section A test. Q: A skip test, whole day shaadi vs B test first, then shaadi (B correct).

Day 90: no vote data (treated B, the correct pick, as the winner). Hook: 'SHAADI SEASON' stamp, boards ka sabse bada trap. What-if A: skips the test, naagin dance at the DJ, Section A list without his name ('par Fufa ji ne sau rupaye diye the!'). Real: up at 6, sherwani on the hanger, 15-min Zeta Real Numbers revision notes; tip: step marks (wrong answer, right steps = still marks). Result 18/20, enters Section A; Pari 19 ('ab asli race shuru'). Reaches the wedding at 11 in uniform. Twist: Fufa ji's shagun = a new phone; Papa: 'deal yaad hai? 90% tabhi phone'. Q: A give it to Papa till boards (correct) vs B secretly keep it.

Day 89: no vote data (treated A, the correct pick, as the winner). Hook: 'DIMAAG' battery charging on a sleeping Chhotu, 'phone roz full charge... dimaag bhi, bas ek tareeke se'. What-if B: phone hidden in a sock, reels till 3 AM, Papa: 'ye moza vibrate kyun kar raha hai?'. Real: seal-pack phone handed to Papa, locked in the almirah 'boards ke baad, tera'; Mummy: family laptop, sirf padhai. New chapter Polynomials on Zeta Flash Cards; tip: sum of zeroes = −b/a, product = c/a. Pari: Section A Polynomials test tomorrow, with graph questions. 11 PM, 3 graph questions left. Q: A stay up till 2 AM vs B sleep now, graph at 6 AM (B correct).
